cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've stacked the cups upside down, so I've done mine. Before your taxi comes, could you check this last one?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are dry. Yours is dripping into the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the drying stage. Could you hold it while I get a towel? One last wipe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've dried it. The taxi's here now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Could you reach the top shelf with it? I'll fetch your coat while you do that.
